mechanism_narrative: If WORKPLACES remains near -80% while TRANSIT stays near its recent trough, weekday retail visits will keep falling because commuting-linked discretionary stops are still suppressed. Over the next four weeks this should push RETAIL_REC lower than in the prior four weeks.
failure_condition: The hypothesis is rejected if WORKPLACES and TRANSIT stay at or below their current levels while RETAIL_REC rises over the next 28 days relative to the previous 28 days.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent rise in RESIDENTIAL time above 33 points indicates more at-home confinement, which directly reduces casual shopping trips and mall visits after a short lag. This should lower RETAIL_REC over the next two weeks.
failure_condition: Reject if RESIDENTIAL remains at or above current levels for two weeks and RETAIL_REC does not decline over the same 14-day window.

mechanism_narrative: When TRANSIT drops below its recent -85% range while WORKPLACES also remains below -80%, the combined mobility collapse signals a tightening-access regime that suppresses retail traffic further. In that case RETAIL_REC should decline over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT falls below -85 and WORKPLACES stays below -80 for two consecutive weekly means
evidence_refs: fact:recent weekly means show TRANSIT near -85 and WORKPLACES near -80
failure_condition: Reject if the threshold condition is met but RETAIL_REC is not lower over the next 28 days than over the last 28 days.

candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM turns upward from a level below -70
failure_condition: Reject if GROCERY_PHARM increases from below -70 and RETAIL_REC does not rise in the following week.

mechanism_narrative: When PARKS remains depressed near or below -75 during warm-weather weeks, outdoor leisure substitutes for retail outings instead of complementing them, which keeps RETAIL_REC weak. This seasonal substitution should lower retail mobility over four weeks.

failure_condition: Reject if PARKS stays at or below -75 for two weeks yet RETAIL_REC rises over the next 28 days.
